phone_checklist: After a full phone reboot, wait for normal system readiness, then record first launch, a force-stopped relaunch, visible UI-ready time and any ANR. Repeat without background downloads. Report exact phone model/OS.
Tune every string with deliberate sharp/flat offsets, then let it decay. Check octave stability.
Run tuner for 10 minutes including sustained voice; switch guitar/chromatic and selected octaves.
Lock/unlock, background/return and interrupt audio. Check recovery and microphone release.
Listen to slow/fast rhythms, rapidly switch previews, verify up/down pattern and F/E chords without clicks.
Preview different fingerings and use capo/transposition; compare sounding pitches with diagrams.
Create/edit a song with cover, restart, verify favorites and reading/rhythm settings.
Export backup, preview/restore, verify covers and settings; cancellation must preserve existing data.
Record while auto-scrolling; replay/export/delete. Check loud and quiet performances. Recordings are not in library backup.
Deny microphone permission, then enable it in device settings. Test offline mode.
Check portrait/landscape, large text and keyboard on a small phone. No overlap or unreachable controls.
When accounts exist, verify purchases, cancellation, pending state and recovery through store sandbox.

Recognize an international song; verify artist/title identity, complete lyrics/chords when available, apostrophes/remaster suffixes, retry after cancellation, a healthy no-match, airplane mode and blocked/slow providers. Never replace reviewed text with a late response.

outstanding.action: Publish docs/privacy.html at a stable public HTTPS URL controlled by the developer, provide a support page and enter both URLs in store metadata. No URL is invented.
On macOS install pods, select signing team, build/archive, verify Privacy Report/SDK manifests and run test-ios-pitch.py plus microphone/recording tests.
Register identifier com.freetune or change identifiers consistently if unavailable. Configure consumable freetune_support, taxes, pricing and tester access.
Capture final device screens, review data-safety/age-rating/rights answers. Do not submit preview collages as genuine device screenshots.

Verify provider availability, automated-access/content permissions and privacy disclosures before publication. The unofficial Shazam endpoint has no contractual availability guarantee. Do not claim that every song has lyrics or chords.

octave_tracking.before: Synthetic D3-to-D2 transition held about 146.9 Hz instead of 73.4 Hz.
octave_tracking.after: Four high-to-low cases at two sample rates, 240 low-note frames, pass together with the pre-existing register, decay, recording and capture checks. Persistent lower fundamentals require measurable independent energy before overriding harmonic history.
octave_tracking.limits: Android production algorithms with device stubs; Swift parity change is not compiled on Windows.

fingering_cache.before: The component skipped native preparation after PCM eviction.
fingering_cache.after: Visible fingering waveforms are retained for cache-miss recovery and readiness is revalidated on tap; the evicted-preview regression plays exactly once.

source_capo.before: Pisennyk returned no capo and unshifted source chords.
source_capo.after: Numeric and spelled Ukrainian capo instructions normalize to sounding chords; paragraph-separated lyrics are retained.
source_capo.live_check: Direct page retrieval returned HTTP 502 during this review; parsing is proved with deterministic numeric, spelled and paragraph fixtures. Public instruction independently checked at https://pisennyk.com.ua/o-torvald/nashi-lyudi-vsyudi.

bracket_parsing.after: Section labels, inline chords and rendered song brackets stop at a new opening bracket; a 196,000-character malformed input has a bounded child-process regression.

recognition_enrichment.before: Ready draft card was disabled and no enrichment-cancel action was available.
recognition_enrichment.after: Ready drafts open immediately; optional enrichment can be cancelled while retaining metadata; navigation invalidates and aborts outstanding requests.

performer_validation.before: Overlong nested performer values blocked saving without a visible error.
performer_validation.after: Common fields read nested Formik values/errors/touched through getIn, retaining the existing performer-change behavior and showing the field error.

recording_deletion.before: Both audio files were removed before an injected SQL deletion failure.
recording_deletion.after: The song deletion and durable cleanup journal commit in one transaction before any file removal. SQL failure preserves files. Cleanup retries surviving files after partial failure or restart, and aborts file removal when the song still exists.

preferences.before: Two flushes opened two unfinished transactions; absent global experience prevented reading independent song chunks.
preferences.after: One save is in flight; successful commits drain newer revisions; failed writes retain a visible retryable error. Nested pauses are counted. Song chunks load independently of the global experience row.

backup_restore.before: Two permitted arrangements restored as one and existing settings were skipped.
backup_restore.after: Exports persist stable record identities, including across numbered parts. Restore matches each existing record at most once per part, preserves distinct arrangements and restores backup preferences onto matches in the same transaction. The confirmation explains that matching settings and artwork are replaced.

backup_limits.after: New normal backups use format version 2 with per-field limits. Legacy version 1 remains readable and exportable for existing oversized data; users receive visible form errors when correcting those fields.
backup_limits.compatibility: Older application versions cannot read version 2 backups. Legacy oversized data is intentionally retained rather than truncated or discarded.

duration_ranking.after: Known optional recognition duration disambiguates versions within five seconds while preserving chord and album priority. Unknown duration does not invent a match.

remaining_boundaries: Physical Android microphone contention, calls, Bluetooth and background interruption checks are still required.
Native iOS compilation and device checks require macOS/Xcode.
Shazam remains an unofficial external dependency; current cancellation, timeout and rate-limit handling do not guarantee availability or usage rights.
Existing versioned migrations and controlled CRUD SQL callers were reviewed; no unsupported migration or SQL-injection claim is marked fixed.
No dependency downgrade or unverified advisory workaround was applied.
No APK, AAB or release R8 assembly was produced in this task.

cover_save.before: Actual editor committed while image processing was unresolved.
cover_save.after: Exit guard blocks while processing; the central submit handler independently checks the synchronous readiness ref. The editor remains open until the selected image is ready.

internal_chord_anchors.before: Capo import changed the literal word Поверь into Пове рь.
internal_chord_anchors.after: Ambiguous internal-word anchors remain standard inline ChordPro in canonical content. Read-only presentation and the fullscreen editor show chord rows above untouched lyrics; overlapping labels use additional chord rows. Editor serialization retains the original anchors. Presentation size is bounded for pathological dense input.
internal_chord_anchors.coverage: Import, repeated transpose/inverse, Unicode prefix, multiple internal anchors, real editor save and backup parse. Existing corrupted words cannot be repaired automatically without the original source.

directive_parser.before: Three real imports with 40,000 blank lines exceeded a bounded child-process timeout.
directive_parser.after: Directive expressions do not cross CR, LF, Unicode line separators or brace boundaries. Interior LF, U+2028 and U+2029 runs are covered by the bounded child-process regression.

local_benchmark.runtime: Node on Windows, not phone measurements

cleanup_queue.before: A second caller returned after the first snapshot, leaving its new journal untouched.
cleanup_queue.after: Every invocation chains a fresh pass after the active pass; conditional finalization cannot erase a newer queued promise.

ios_recording_files.before: Swift had no interrupted-file reconciliation and removed only the main take. Source-confirmed baseline; not executed on an iPhone.
ios_recording_files.after: Initialization and listing reconcile managed file families. Completed AAC output is recovered when necessary, invalid leftovers and empty finals are cleaned, nonempty originals are retained, and active capture/processing is protected. Deletion handles the companion file and tolerates retries.
ios_recording_files.status: Passed macOS 15 CI with real AAC encoding/decoding: incomplete cleanup, completed-file recovery, original retention, active capture/processing protection, family deletion and idempotent retry. Not an iPhone or full iOS app test.

default_fingering.before: Highlighted Cm was X 3 1 0 1 3 while rhythm used X 3 5 5 4 3.
default_fingering.after: Cards, rhythm and practice use the same selectedChordShape resolver. Valid explicit selection takes priority, then the recorded voicing, then the available fallback. All 24 recorded defaults are covered.

repository_policy.note: Public repository API rechecked during this review. Enabling required checks and choosing a PR/direct-push policy remain a repository administration decision.

combination_review.artifacts: No new APK, AAB or IPA. Listed rc15 packages do not contain these changes.
boundaries: No physical Android/iPhone, Bluetooth, calls or store purchases checked.
A macOS helper-method check does not compile the full React Native iOS app or validate AVAudioSession.

source_ci.status: Both current workflows passed, including native and ios jobs.

permission_lifecycle.before: The real recognition screen cancelled during the permission Activity pause, then made zero native capture calls after permission was granted.
permission_lifecycle.after: Permission and foreground readiness are separate from native capture. Background events before capture do not cancel the permission request; capture waits for active AppState and an unaborted operation. Closing the screen still aborts waiting; backgrounding after capture starts still cancels. A brief active/background sequence is rechecked before starting.
permission_lifecycle.boundary: Component/native-boundary tests only; physical Android permission UI was not exercised.

deleted_song_preferences.before: Unmount after confirmed deletion recreated default preferences with the last scroll position.
deleted_song_preferences.after: Successful deletion marks that song ID before navigation. Position writes require a live preference record and an undeleted owner; stale load results and generic edits also respect the deletion marker.

literal_search.before: Actual SQLite queries for %, _, A_B and 100% returned unrelated titles.
literal_search.after: The real Library query escapes !, % and _ and declares ! as its SQL LIKE escape character. Values remain bound parameters. Backslash remains literal.

permission_search_review.readme: README now states that restore applies backup preferences and artwork to matching records, preserves distinct arrangements by backup identity, and uses numbered parts. It advises saving current settings first.

supplementary_risks.interrupted_android_take: Unchanged: a capture/read or encoding failure can discard the Android take, as explicitly documented in README. Recovery of captured frames needs a separate native change and tests.
supplementary_risks.cloud_provider_cancellation: Unchanged, source-level risk: ContentResolver opening/reading is not proven cancellable against a delaying provider. A device/provider scenario and cancellation latency measurement remain necessary.
supplementary_risks.native_checks: No current native source changes. Previous successful Android compilation, Kotlin/Rust and macOS Swift/AAC method checks remain relevant but do not exercise the full application, AVAudioSession or content-provider recognition path.
supplementary_risks.external_checks: Optional external steps in combined workflows do not establish service availability by overall workflow status. The separate shazam-real-audio-proof workflow has a strict recognition assertion; inspect actual live-step outcomes before release.

permission_search_review.artifacts: No APK, AAB or IPA built for these source fixes.
